title: Recovering Benefit the Supplement Paid the Policyholder Directly for Days It Did Not Cover
content:
Money a policy under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies paid on a day the policy did not cover is recovered from whoever received it, and where that money reached the policyholder herself it is she who sends it back.

What the policyholder is asked to send back is fixed only after the claim record carries the entry taking back what the supplement paid on the lines that fall outside cover and reached someone other than her. Until such an entry stands on the claim record, the figure asked of her is not settled.

Sending the money back is the policyholder's own act. It is booked against the named line as money the plan has recovered from her, the liability that line records as standing to her credit is recorded with it, the year's deductible accumulator falls by that credited amount, and the entry stands on the claim record beside the line it answers with a status showing the money has been recovered.

## Taking the repayment

The repayment is made with `repay_direct_benefit_f162ba18`, which is the policyholder's own tool: the representative unlocks it and hands it over, and it is run by the customer themselves. One call hands over one repayment, and the money leaves the account she is paying from.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form it takes |
|---|---|---|
| `medigap_policy_id` | The reference number of the Medicare Supplement policy the line sits on, read from the policy record held for her | An identifier |
| `customer_id` | Her own member reference number, read from her member profile | An identifier |
| `source_claim_id` | The reference number of the single processed crossover line the money answers, read from the claims that crossed over to that policy | An identifier |
| `medicare_claim_number` | The number Medicare gave the original claim, carried over from that line exactly as it stands there | A thirteen-character Medicare claim control number |
| `date_of_service` | The date the service was rendered, carried over from that line | Written as YYYY-MM-DD |
| `repayment_amount` | The money she is sending back now, in USD | Recorded to 2 decimal places and never negative; it is booked against the policy as a negative payment |
| `liability_credited` | The liability the line records as standing to her credit once the money is back, in USD | Recorded to 2 decimal places and never negative |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence in plain text naming the reference number of the new claim record, the line it answers, the money returned and the liability credited. Receiving that sentence is what says the money has been taken and the entry stands on the claim record; no other value is returned.
